Cave Passive Pedals browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Cave Passive Pedals The Wasp Published on April 19, 2010 Cave Passive Pedals fuzz pedal Information Cave Passive Pedals With a harsher overdrive than the Grunt, The Wasp's effect can be classed as Fuzz Tone! More musical than it's digital counterparts, this analogue fuzz for bass has a rotary control for depth which creates a variety of tones from 60's hippy to hard rock.
